summaryZh: 能被 redis-cli 连上的服务器：RESP 解析、二进制安全、管道和半包、SET 的 NX/XX/EX/PX、TTL 和 INCR。
summaryEn: A server redis-cli can talk to: RESP parsing, binary-safe values, pipelining and split frames, SET with NX/XX/EX/PX, TTL and INCR.

milestones.zh: TCP 服务器和 RESP 解析：按长度读 bulk string，处理半包和管道
milestones.en: The TCP server and RESP parser: length-prefixed bulk strings, split frames and pipelining

milestones.zh: SET/GET/DEL/EXISTS/INCR 和错误回复，用 redis-cli 手动试
milestones.en: SET/GET/DEL/EXISTS/INCR and error replies, tried by hand with redis-cli
Expiry with EX/PX/EXPIRE/TTL, passing the acceptance script

milestones.zh: 并发模型（多线程或事件循环）、redis-benchmark 压测和 README
milestones.en: The concurrency model (threads or an event loop), a redis-benchmark run and the README

bulletZh: 用 {语言} 实现兼容 RESP2 的 Redis 子集服务器（字符串、过期、管道），可直接用 redis-cli 连接；基于 {事件循环/线程池}，redis-benchmark 下达到真 Redis 的 {X}%。
bulletEn: Built a RESP2-compatible Redis subset server in {language} (strings, expiry, pipelining) that redis-cli connects to directly; {event loop / thread pool} design reaching {X}% of real Redis in redis-benchmark.

deepDive.zh: TCP 是字节流，你怎么知道一条命令收齐了？半包和粘包分别怎么处理？
deepDive.en: TCP is a byte stream. How do you know a command is complete, and how do you handle split and coalesced frames?

deepDive.zh: Redis 为什么是单线程还能这么快？你的服务器用的是什么并发模型？
deepDive.en: Why is Redis fast while single-threaded, and what concurrency model does your server use?

deepDive.zh: 过期 key 什么时候真正删除？只在访问时删会有什么问题？
deepDive.en: When are expired keys actually deleted, and what goes wrong if you only delete on access?

deepDive.zh: 管道（pipelining）为什么能提升吞吐？服务器需要做什么特别的事吗？
deepDive.en: Why does pipelining raise throughput, and does the server need to do anything special?

deepDive.zh: INCR 在多客户端下怎么保证原子？如果要实现 MULTI/EXEC 呢？
deepDive.en: How is INCR atomic across clients, and what would MULTI/EXEC take?

deepDive.zh: 要持久化的话，AOF 和 RDB 各有什么取舍？
deepDive.en: For persistence, what are the trade-offs between AOF and RDB?
